command.mac:
claude plugin uninstall ponytail@ponytail
claude plugin list
command.powershell:
claude plugin uninstall ponytail@ponytail
claude plugin list

context:
Your PC runs ponytail 4.10.0 although your Claude Code settings list it as turned off (your setup audit session, 16:40 CST); cloud sessions stopped running it once the shared settings turned it off at 12:38 CST. Removing it from your PC is the fix on that machine. Why that setting did not stop it is still being looked into.
Why yours: the plugin is on your PC only, and no folder of yours is shared through Remote Control (list_computer_folders, Nov 1 16:56 CST), so no session here can reach it.
ref: step ponytail-local-still-on (ponytail still runs on your PC)
reply: No prompt needed. Open a new session in the desktop app and type /plugin. If ponytail is not in the list, mark this done.
steps: Done: the command removed ponytail from your user plugins.
In a new desktop app session, type /plugin.
If ponytail is not listed, mark this done.
title: Remove ponytail from your PC, where it still runs although your settings turn it off
